rule: Ich bin says who you are, and du bist says who someone you know well is: both are forms of sein, the verb for who or what someone is. Every noun has a gender and starts with a capital letter: ein goes with a masculine or neuter noun (ein Mann, ein Kind), eine with a feminine one (eine Frau). To say not, put nicht after the verb (Ich bin nicht Tom). In a question the verb comes first: Bist du Tom?
